seo.title: CopyPump — Follow smart money. Keep control.
seo.description: We’re building autonomous trading on Solana. Your wallet stays yours. Your rules define what automation is allowed to do.

hero.title: Follow smart money.
hero.copy: Building automated trading on Solana, within limits you set. CopyPump evaluates selected wallet activity; you keep your keys, and every action must pass the risk rules.
hero.stage: Technical alpha · Devnet validation · Mainnet not open

architecture.title: Your wallet.
architecture.copy: CopyPump separates analysis, authorization and execution. Neither connecting a wallet nor receiving an AI recommendation grants unlimited access to assets.

cards.title: Assets stay under user custody.
cards.copy: Private keys remain with the user. CopyPump is designed around explicit authority rather than asset possession.

deepDive.meaning: The wallet and its private keys remain under the user’s control.
deepDive.matters: Automation should not require transferring ownership of assets to the platform.
can: Operate only inside the configured envelope
cannot: Silently move funds outside defined authority

cards.title: Execution authority is bounded.
cards.copy: Allowed actions, capital limits and revocable permissions define the automation envelope.

deepDive.meaning: Automation receives only the permissions required for an allowed action.
deepDive.matters: Authority should be explicit, revocable and smaller than the wallet itself.
can: Stop when authority is invalid or expired
cannot: Treat wallet connection as unlimited authority

cards.title: Safety gates are deterministic.
cards.copy: AI-assisted analysis can inform a candidate but cannot bypass capital, exposure or permission controls.

deepDive.meaning: Every candidate must pass deterministic safety rules before execution.
deepDive.matters: AI can assist analysis, but it must not overrule hard risk boundaries.
can: Record the reason for a decision
cannot: Convert a failed policy into an approval

cards.title: Material states are inspectable.
cards.copy: Signal, decision, execution and reconciliation states are designed to produce an auditable trail.

deepDive.meaning: Important state changes are designed to leave inspectable evidence.
deepDive.matters: A trustworthy automation system should be able to explain what happened and why.
cannot: Replace missing evidence with a marketing claim

stack.title: AI informs.
stack.copy: AI assists research and explains decisions. It does not sign or submit transactions, grant wallet permissions, or override a rejection from the risk rules.
stack.boundaryCopy: Signing stays at the wallet boundary. Risk checks remain mandatory.

workflow.title: From signal to trade.
workflow.copy: The intended flow: detect, qualify, constrain, then execute a permitted action. Confirmation, position reconciliation and fee accounting follow. The full lifecycle is still being verified on Devnet.

cards.title: Detect
cards.copy: Observe selected smart-money activity and normalize candidate signals.

cards.title: Qualify
cards.copy: Reject weak candidates before capital is considered.

cards.title: Constrain
cards.copy: Apply deterministic capital, slippage, exposure and permission gates.

cards.title: Execute + prove
cards.copy: Only permitted actions proceed; the resulting state is reconciled and evidenced.

evidence.title: Beyond promises.
evidence.copy: Website health and trading readiness are separate. A working site and a successful build do not prove that the product is ready to trade with real funds.
evidence.note: The fingerprint identifies this website build only. Trading proof requires reviewed Devnet transactions, position reconciliation and fee accounting. Profitability is neither verified nor guaranteed.

roadmap.title: Full Devnet lifecycle
roadmap.copy: BUY → POSITION → PARTIAL SELL → FULL SELL. Confirm transactions, reconcile state, account for fees and review the execution record.

roadmap.label: PUBLISH

roadmap.copy: Publish evidence, selected tests and source only after security, privacy and licensing review.

roadmap.label: AFTER THE GATES

roadmap.copy: Evaluate readiness for tightly constrained Mainnet operation. This is a conditional next step, not an access or launch-date promise.

history.title: From idea to system.
history.copy: From watching wallets to a system that separates insight from permission to act. The architecture is publicly documented; the complete trading lifecycle still needs reviewed evidence.

items.label: THE IDEA
items.title: Follow activity without giving up custody.
items.copy: CopyPump began with a simple question: can selected smart-money activity be followed automatically while the wallet remains under the user’s control?

items.label: CONTROL
items.title: Automation needed explicit authority.
items.copy: The architecture specifies bounded authority, capital limits and revocation. Documenting these boundaries does not replace verifying execution.

items.label: SAFETY
items.title: Safety came before scale.
items.copy: Fail-closed behavior, reconciliation and a decision trail became system requirements. Readiness depends on verification, not on the interface.

items.label: TECHNICAL ALPHA
items.title: Harden. Verify. Share the evidence.
items.copy: The September 8 public update reports expanded Price Alerts checks. Final browser QA and independent review are still required. Mainnet remains blocked.

items.label: NEXT
items.title: The next milestone is evidence.
items.copy: The next goal is a reviewed Devnet lifecycle. Mandatory safety checks and an assessment of strictly limited real-network operation follow. No launch date is claimed.

history.closing: The next milestone is not more promises. It is evidence.

currentState.copy: Technical alpha on Solana, with a Phantom-focused wallet flow. Devnet verification is underway; public real-fund trading is not available.

projectRoadmap.title: Progress by evidence.
projectRoadmap.copy: Every stage has an exit condition. We publish the work and the checks — not a launch date before the result is validated.

phases.label: DOCUMENTED
phases.title: Architecture and boundaries
phases.copy: Custody, authority, AI boundaries and risk principles are documented. This describes the model; it is not a completed security audit.

phases.label: CURRENT
phases.title: Technical alpha
phases.copy: Devnet validation, execution safety, alerts, EN/RU public experience, evidence surfaces and product hardening.
phases.gate: Review Devnet transactions, reconciled positions and fee accounting.

phases.label: NEXT
phases.title: Bounded Mainnet evaluation
phases.copy: Only after mandatory safety gates close: evaluate owner-only operation with small personal capital. No third-party funds or public access.
phases.gate: First close safety, authorization, recovery and capital-limit gates.

phases.label: EVIDENCE
phases.title: Measure actual outcomes
phases.copy: The planned measurement window is 30 / 60 / 90 days after limited real-network operation is permitted. This is future work, not an existing performance record.

phases.label: DECIDE
phases.title: Expansion decision
phases.copy: Only after evidence exists: decide company/legal structure, broader access and production operating scope.

why.title: A signal is a start.
why.copy: Smart money means wallet activity the system studies for potential signals. CopyPump is designed to qualify that activity, check your limits and permissions, and only then prepare an allowed action.

journey.title: One signal.
journey.copy: A simplified illustrative flow showing where CopyPump adds qualification, policy, reconciliation and proof. It is not a live transaction or performance claim.

steps.label: SIGNAL
steps.title: Activity is detected.
steps.copy: A monitored source produces a candidate event. Detection alone does not authorize execution.

steps.label: QUALIFY
steps.title: The candidate is evaluated.
steps.copy: Freshness, market conditions and quality checks decide whether the signal is worth considering.

steps.label: POLICY
steps.title: Hard boundaries decide.
steps.copy: Capital, exposure, slippage and authority rules must allow the action before execution can proceed.

steps.label: EXECUTE
steps.title: Only an allowed action is prepared.
steps.copy: A valid candidate is converted into an execution request inside the permitted envelope.

steps.label: RECONCILE
steps.title: Expected and observed state are compared.
steps.copy: The system checks what actually happened instead of assuming that submission means success.

steps.label: PROVE
steps.title: The decision leaves evidence.
steps.copy: Policy context, transaction state, timestamps and reconciliation outcome become part of the audit trail.

journey.closing: Nothing jumps directly from signal to wallet.

failure.title: When in doubt.
failure.copy: The intended safety model stops execution when required data, authority or confirmation is missing. These failure paths are part of the ongoing verification work.

cards.title: RPC unavailable
cards.copy: Execution does not silently continue without the network state it requires.

cards.title: Policy fails
cards.copy: The candidate is blocked. A failed rule cannot be converted into an approval.

cards.title: State cannot reconcile
cards.copy: The system surfaces the mismatch instead of pretending the expected result occurred.

cards.title: Authority invalid
cards.copy: Execution stops when the required permission is missing, expired or revoked.

philosophy.title: Less noise.
philosophy.copy: Clear boundaries are more useful than big claims. They help you decide whether to follow the project now, and understand what it does not offer yet.

items.title: Prove before expansion
items.copy: New scope follows evidence, not pressure to announce more.

items.title: Control before convenience
items.copy: Automation remains bounded even when removing a boundary would feel easier.

items.title: Evidence before claims
items.copy: If a capability is not connected and proven end to end, the public site says so.

items.question: Can I trade through CopyPump today?
items.answer: No. The product is in technical alpha, full Devnet verification is ongoing, and Mainnet is intentionally blocked. This website lets you explore the model and an illustrative demo, not start trading with real funds.

items.question: Do I have to hand over my wallet or keys?
items.answer: No. The intended model does not require your seed phrase or private key. Signing stays at the supported Phantom wallet boundary. AI analysis does not grant transaction-signing authority or permission to expand wallet access.

items.question: What proves the next milestone?
items.answer: A Devnet buy, partial sell and full sell, with transaction confirmation, position reconciliation and fee accounting. Separate safety gates still follow: a successful demonstration alone does not close them.

bullets: No seed phrase or private key is requested.
The public project site does not require a wallet connection.
External links are governed by the privacy practices of their respective services.

terms.description: Terms governing use of the public CopyPump website and technical-alpha information.
terms.intro: The public CopyPump website is an informational and experimental technical-alpha surface. It is not a promise that public trading access, mainnet execution or any commercial service is available.

sections.heading: Technical-alpha status
paragraphs: CopyPump is under active development. Features, architecture, interfaces, status indicators and validation plans may change.

sections.heading: No investment or financial advice
paragraphs: Nothing on the website is investment, legal, tax or financial advice.

sections.heading: No public mainnet promise
paragraphs: Mainnet access remains locked unless and until the project explicitly changes that status.

sections.heading: Acceptable use

sections.heading: Availability and changes

security.title: Security & Responsible Disclosure
security.description: How to report a potential security issue affecting the public CopyPump website.
security.intro: Security reports are welcome. Please disclose vulnerabilities privately so the project can investigate before technical details are made public.

sections.heading: Report privately
paragraphs: Send a concise report to copypumphq@gmail.com with the subject “CopyPump Security”. Include the affected URL or component, reproduction steps and expected impact.

sections.heading: Safe research
paragraphs: Do not access data belonging to other users, degrade service availability, perform social engineering or use a vulnerability beyond what is needed to demonstrate it safely.

sections.heading: Authentication safety
paragraphs: CopyPump will never ask you to send a seed phrase or private key. The public project website never requires a seed phrase or private key.

sections.heading: Current public boundary
paragraphs: The public website is separate from any future real-funds execution surface. Mainnet trading remains locked unless explicitly announced.

contact.intro: Use official channels for project questions, collaboration, security reports and development updates.

sections.heading: Before you contact us

items.a: Public Mainnet trading is not available. The project is in technical alpha and is hardening its Solana Devnet lifecycle. This website explains the product, boundaries and current development status.

items.q: Do I need a wallet to explore the site?
items.a: No. The product explanation, interactive example and public project documents are open without a wallet connection.

items.q: How are CopyPump development updates published?
items.a: CopyPump now uses a public-safe milestone feed for development announcements. A milestone must be verified and explicitly approved for public announcement; private engineering progress is not automatically presented as a public milestone.
No. CopyPump is an independent project. Official channels, technical documentation and contact details are linked below.
The described architecture does not give AI that authority. AI can assist with research, classification, diagnostics and explanations; deterministic risk and policy checks remain authoritative.

items.q: Why is confirmation not the end of a trade?
items.a: CopyPump’s target model also checks the resulting balances and position, and records fees and the decision trail. A correct interface message alone does not establish that the position is reconciled.

items.q: Where can I check the claims on this page?
items.a: The architecture, security model, project status and roadmap are linked beside the relevant sections. They describe a technical alpha and intended boundaries, not verified profitability or production Mainnet readiness.

rows.after: Keep an inspectable trail from signal to decision and outcome.

items.title: Find activity worth understanding.
items.text: Smart-money discovery starts with wallet and transaction activity. An interesting move is an observation, not an instruction to buy.

items.title: Context before copying.
items.text: The intended qualification layer looks at the opportunity and manipulation signals before preparing an action. Following a wallet is not blind execution.

items.title: Their move. Your limits.
items.text: Capital, exposure, daily loss boundaries, token restrictions, liquidity and slippage checks define the permitted scope. A strategy cannot grant itself more authority.

items.title: Your wallet is a boundary.
items.text: A permitted intent still needs the required wallet or session authority. AI may explain and propose; it cannot sign, submit or override a rejection.
items.detail: No seed phrase or private-key custody

items.title: Buying is only the beginning.
items.text: The target lifecycle includes position creation, partial selling and full closing. The remaining position has to stay consistent after every action.

items.title: The receipt matters too.
items.text: Transaction confirmation, balances, positions, fees and the audit trail belong to the result. A submitted request alone is not proof of correct execution.

items.title: Prove the Devnet lifecycle.
items.text: Phantom flow, qualified signals, BUY, a position, partial and full exits — with confirmation, reconciliation and fee accounting.
items.detail: A reviewed real-Devnet execution trail, including failures and restart behavior.

items.title: Make recovery part of safety.
items.text: Close the gaps around duplicate execution, session replay, emergency stops, ownership of execution and operational recovery.
items.detail: Required safety checks closed; backup and restore behavior verified.

items.title: Build in the open, carefully.
items.text: Keep architecture and security documentation reviewable. Publish selected source and tests only after security, privacy and licensing review.
items.detail: Public documentation is available. Selected reviewed code and reproducible evidence remain milestones.

items.title: Evaluate limited operation.
items.text: Only after the safety gates: assess bounded production limits, staged rollout, monitoring, incident response and provider redundancy.
items.detail: Mainnet remains intentionally blocked. This stage needs a separate evidence-based decision.
